reader.requirement: At 85 a VALUE clause (format 1) must be refused in a data description entry that contains a REDEFINES clause or is subordinate to one, in every section that admits item VALUEs (Working-Storage and Communication; File and Linkage refuse item VALUEs anyway), while a condition-name (88) VALUE under such an entry stays legal.
reader.edition-search: Read ScreenItemValuePlacement/EntryWithClause and its one call site in DataBinder.BindEntries; grep for DialectLevel, CobolVersion, ConstructRegistry, DialectBehavior, ReservedWords, Edition.Edition in DataBinder.ValuePlacement.cs: none. COBOL2406 is EditionSeverity.Error at every edition; Edition.Error only records it.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (2023's format 2 table VALUE is an extra carrier the screen also reads; 1985 has no such format)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb550 covers only the legal neighbours (anchor VALUE, 88 under REDEFINES); the refusal half (VALUE on the redefining entry, on a subordinate of it, on a group REDEFINES, on an 01 REDEFINES, in the Communication Section) is not exercised by it
